name: ObjView Benchmark (ObjView-Bench)
description: ObjView-Bench distributes benchmark metadata for 3D assets aligned with Objaverse 1.0: normalization parameters (translation center and scale from Poisson-disk samples on GLB meshes) and fixed labels for omnidirectional self-occlusion, observation saturation difficulty, and planning difficulty. Rasterized meshes and textures are not included; scripts document how to fetch GLBs and reproduce normalized geometry.
citeAs: @article{pan2026objviewbench, title = {ObjView-Bench: Rethinking Difficulty and Deployment for Object-Centric View Planning}, author = {Pan, Sicong and Hu, Hao and Huang, Xuying and Wingender, Benno and Bennewitz, Maren}, journal = {arXiv preprint arXiv:2605.10707}, year = {2026}}
rai:dataBiases: Objaverse reflects community upload patterns (categories, quality, geographic and cultural skew) and licensing heterogeneity; downstream models may inherit these biases.
rai:dataCollection: Object identities and source meshes originate from Objaverse 1.0 (community-uploaded 3D models with associated licenses). This release adds derived normalization statistics and benchmark labels from the ObjView benchmark pipeline.
rai:dataLimitations: Benchmark label fields are released as fixed values for the listed UIDs. This dataset bundle contains labels, normalization metadata, and geometry-preprocessing scripts; the benchmark code that produced the labels is at https://github.com/objview-bench/objview_bench. Full meshes must be obtained under Objaverse and per-asset licenses. Labels reflect dataset construction choices and may not transfer to other domains.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Meshes: load GLB, Poisson-disk sample surface points, set translation_center to the sample mean and scale to the max L2 distance from that center.
Optional geometry pipeline: download GLB via objaverse; convert with Blender 4.2.x to OBJ with a single baked texture; normalize OBJ vertices with the same center and scale.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Intended for academic and non-deceptive research. Misuse could include surveillance-oriented 3D reconstruction or synthetic data generation without respecting source licenses; users should comply with Objaverse and asset-level terms.
rai:dataUseCases: Empirical research on multi-view 3D understanding, active view selection, and navigation policies evaluated on fixed object-centric assets.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No personal identifiers. UIDs identify 3D assets, not individuals.

prov:wasDerivedFrom.name: Objaverse 1.0
prov:wasDerivedFrom.description: Source 3D assets and their per-asset licenses. This release derives UIDs, normalization metadata, and benchmark labels from those assets and does not redistribute the meshes.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.name: Objaverse++ quality prefiltering
prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: Asset identities were selected from Objaverse 1.0 after Objaverse++ quality prefiltering. This step restricts which source assets enter the benchmark; it does not add Objaverse difficulty labels.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.name: Geometry filtering and normalization
prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: Remaining meshes were geometry-filtered. For each released UID, translation_center and scale were computed from Poisson-disk samples on the GLB surface: translation_center is the sample mean, and scale is the maximum L2 distance from that center. These normalization fields are derived metadata, not Objaverse attributes.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.name: Inverse visibility and saturation annotation
prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: omnidirectional_self_occlusion_attribute and observation_saturation_difficulty were computed automatically by inverse-visibility and observation-saturation annotation. These benchmark labels are algorithm outputs. Objaverse does not provide them.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.name: Integer-programming set-cover difficulty annotation
prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: planning_difficulty was computed by an integer-programming set-cover procedure over views. This benchmark difficulty label is calculated by the ObjView pipeline and is not an original Objaverse label.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.name: Manual reliability review
prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: The authors manually reviewed reliability of the automatically computed benchmark labels on the released splits before publication. The review audits the algorithmic labels; it does not replace them with tags from Objaverse. This release contains metadata and algorithm labels only, and no separately generated synthetic data samples.
